name: PlankFloor
height_note: H 0..65535 spans height_range_m; mid level about 0.781

colour_spaces.N: linear, OpenGL (+Y up); flip green on Unreal import
colour_spaces.ORM: linear; R AO, G roughness, B metallic 0
colour_spaces.Macro: linear; R large, G medium, B small low-frequency variation, sample at 1/6 to 1/10 of the tile UV scale

method: Poly Haven old_wood_floor (worn, gapped softwood boards with nail heads and traffic wear), warmed to the original floor brown
known_weaknesses: boards are narrow (about 12 cm) and run across the full tile width: butt joints are rare; single scan
